person.persName: أحمد بن موسى بن عبد الواحد
أحمد بن موسى بن عبد الواحد

death.note: The entry instructs to reconcile this information with the preceding entry or section, suggesting a need to consolidate biographical data regarding the subject's identification.

event.desc: Some sources identify the subject as Aḥmad b. Mūsā b. Yūsuf b. Abī Ḥammū.

person.note: アフマド・ブン・ムーサー・ブン・アブドゥルワーヒド。イブン・アビー・ハンムーについて。タリムサーンのナーイブであるアフマド・ブン・ムーサー・ブン・ユースフ・ブン・アビー・ハンムーは839年に亡くなった、という説を見た。これは前述の人物と併記すべきである。

Aḥmad b. Mūsā b. ʿAbd al-Wāḥid. Regarding Ibn Abī Ḥammū: I have seen it said that Aḥmad b. Mūsā b. Yūsuf b. Abī Ḥammū, nāʾib of Tilimsān, died in the year 839. This should be reconciled with the preceding information.

note.p: Cross-reference (cr): AIND-D00703 (أحمد بن أبي حمو موسى بن عبد الواحد). The entry contains a variant account identifying the subject as Aḥmad b. Mūsā b. Yūsuf b. Abī Ḥammū, nāʾib of Tilimsān, dated to year 839 H. Al-Sakhāwī instructs reconciliation (fiharra) with the preceding entry (D01665), indicating the identification remains unresolved. The primary entry (D00703) dates the subject's death to 865 H.
